start.gate: no worktree yet; user requested start
start.prompt: work items / slugs from user message

describe.gate: after start + first sheep-status; task.original present or collected in chat
describe.prompt: worktree path, task id, chat / optional path

spec.gate: chat or optional on-disk story/status context; predecessor story not required
spec.prompt: worktree path, task id, chat / optional path

subtasks.gate: status open_questions empty; if spec present, its open_questions empty
subtasks.prompt: worktree path, task id, chat / optional path

execute.gate: chat or optional on-disk subtasks; predecessor subtasks file not required
execute.prompt: worktree path, task id, chat / optional path

review.gate: diff + available current-task files; partial review_scope from review_input needs user confirm
review.prompt: worktree path, task id, chat / review_scope when partial

acceptance.gate: readiness.status is ready_for_acceptance; user accepts on disk summary

sync.gate: user confirmed; readiness not fix_required, blocked, or rerun_review
sync.user_confirm: local commit, merge main into feature branch, push feature branch

archive.gate: sync artifact exists; pre_push_merge merged on sync handoff

integrate.gate: sync artifact exists; archive artifact exists; user confirmed merge into main and push main
integrate.user_confirm: merge feature into main and push main to remote

gate_policy.description: Read by check-gate.py. Per-step flags: user_confirm_required (deny without --user-confirmed, using that step's user_confirm sentence as the reason), adhoc_allowed (may run with --mode adhoc; start/close/done omit it or set false). Absent means false. Denials are never waived; --mode adhoc/jump only change update-status write semantics and policy bookends (adhoc_allowed; jump cannot target start/close/done).

sheep_return_contract.description: Every sheep ends its final message with compact JSON. Nicki forwards the return plus the --step and --mode she dispatched to sheep-status. Sheep do not name pipeline position — update-status.py derives completed_step from --step and next_step from routing.
sheep_return_contract.on_blocked: set completed_status to blocked; populate open_questions

harness_failure.prompt: worktree path, failed script route, script input, expected output contract, actual failure context, blocked pipeline step

bootstrap-context.py.notes: Exit 0 whenever contract JSON is printed. Malformed review_validation sets readiness null and readiness_error (string) — not a harness failure. Missing registry / status.json still exit 1 with empty stdout.

update-status.py.notes: Nicki passes --step and --mode. With a completed step, next_step is derived from routing (not required in the summary). Position-only writes (no completed step) still require summary next_step. Missing required field → written false. Success: written true plus path, completed_step (value or null), next_step, mode, blockers. Input error is not a harness failure; retry sheep-status with corrected JSON.
